verdict.rationale: Oneleet documents an API/MCP server and service keys for AI-agent automation, showing some UI functionality is exposed programmatically, but there is no evidence of an OpenAPI spec or comprehensive API surface (probes for openapi.json/swagger.json/llms.txt all 404), and no documentation enumerating which UI workflows (policies, frameworks, trust center, findings triage, MDM, etc.) are actually API-accessible. Missing for 10: a published OpenAPI/API reference showing full coverage, explicit confirmation that all major UI actions (policy publishing, framework management, findings triage, trust center setup) are achievable via API, and independent verification of API completeness.
